caption: The drawing depicts a large, broken bell composed mainly of shades of brown and reddish-brown, with variations of lighter and darker tones throughout its surface to suggest texture and age. The bell is fractured in multiple places, with several visible cracks and missing pieces, particularly at the top and the lower edge. Strips of yellowish material, likely rope or cord, are depicted as wrapped around the bell in various directions, appearing to bind and reinforce the damaged structure. The bell rests on a flat, neutral background with no other objects present. The composition centers the bell on the paper, and there is a small section of text in the bottom right corner, which provides information about the artist and date.
title: Wooden Bell
